subject: english
question: **Select the sentence that contains the MISSPELT word from the given options.**

options.text: Both of them were best friends, now they are at daggers drawn.
As if to fill the small hours of that cold night with warm thoughts, I picked up the book and started browsing.
Without the slightest warning, something new breaks into your life that you may be completely unconscious of.
The gist of the quote was that all reasonable men adopt themselves to the world.

solution:
The correct answer is: "*The gist of the quote was that all reasonable men adopt themselves to the world.*"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The misspelt word is "adopt", which should be spelt as "adapt".
 
• **Adopt **means to legally take another person's child into one's own family and raise it as one's own, or to choose or take on something such as a method, idea, or policy.
 
 
• **Example**: *The couple decided to adopt a child from an orphanage.*
 
 
 
• **Adapt **means to make suitable changes in something to make it fit for a new use or purpose, or to adjust to new conditions.
 
 
• **Example**: *Animals in the Arctic have adapted to the cold environment by growing thick fur.*
 
 
 
• The correct sentence should be "*The gist of the quote was that all reasonable men adapt themselves to the world.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
